text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin JF, which Daitaku Helios
had been waiting for so eagerly—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Who's it gonna be this year... in the Classic tier—
...Yeah, I'm betting on that girl...—
The papers are saying...—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uhyaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's so crazy hyped up!
This is on another level, isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So this is a GⅠ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahaha~...
For some bizarre reason, I'm the one getting nervous!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's take a selfie!
With the racetrack in the background!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!
Let me join in too!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Helios...!?
A-Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I wanna take the photos myself!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well then...
Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right next to Palmer-chin~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Me too!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy☆
Trai-pi, take a pic~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're holding a photoshoot.
Isn't that girl... running today?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Helios~! Take a pic with us too☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyy~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, shouldn't we take a pic with everyone?
Trainy, fly up in the air!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, with Daitaku Helios at the center, the excitement ramped up before the race—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—I made it!
*flail flail*☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, you filmed right down to the wire, didn't you?
Are you mentally prepared? You doing okay?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're just gonna mess around like always!
Piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Messing around...? I'm totally serious here.
What is with you...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Making such a fuss before the race...
She's really taking this lightly, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, everyone's way too chill!
Make some more noise☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
Don't bother me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Today's our festival, y'know!
How can we not get super hyped up!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? A festival?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right? Everyone running today
is super lit from our gen, riiight??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ain't nobody here who isn't hyped to the max, right???
How could we not turn up the heat?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Our generation parties the hardest!
We gotta show this dance floor what's up!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I don't get it!
Besides, it's not like I'm slacking off.
I'm already plenty motivated without you telling me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, time to warm up.
I don't wanna lose to someone like that!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fuuu！

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Things are heating up nicely, aren't they?
A festival's gotta be fiery, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Phew, I thought things were about to blow up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're incredible, Helios!
You actually end up boosting everyone else's motivation instead!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, everyone's just my homies!
They know I'm trying to hype things up, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Club or wherever, hyping things up is what it's all about☆
Besides, it's pretty much all party animals anyway, for real!
choice_data_list: Still, who was today's biggest party animal?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes!
Me!!
